title: Security
two_factor_help: Protect password sign-in with a code from your authenticator app.
pending: Confirm a code to finish setup. Protection is not active yet.
scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
recovery_help: Save your recovery codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator.
passkeys_help: Sign in using your device PIN or biometrics instead of a password and authenticator code. Keep your password for account recovery and sensitive profile changes.
unsupported: Passkeys require a supported browser and a secure connection.
request_error: Request failed. Refresh this page to confirm your identity again if needed, then retry.
passkey_error: Passkey operation failed. Check your connection and device, or refresh this page to confirm your identity again.
cancelled: Passkey operation cancelled. You can try again.
challenge_help: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
